DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome (presenting with apnea/anemia, likely due to thrombocytopenia and pulmonary artery banding/ductal issues).

Based on the history of maternal non-immunity to rubella and prematurity, I am requesting specific lab work to confirm the diagnosis.
